name: @epoch/adapter-apify
description: Epoch Apify acquisition adapter (W054, ACR-006) — the external-source implementation of the FROZEN W045 DiscoverySourceAdapter contract over the Apify REST API: runs the PINNED actor (EPOCH_APIFY_ACTOR_ID) via POST /v2/acts/{actorId}/run-sync-get-dataset-items (fetch-ahead at an EXPLICIT caller-invoked refresh — never a timer, never wall-clock; scan() stays SYNCHRONOUS over the cached dataset like the StaticCatalogSourceAdapter reference), maps dataset items to provider-neutral SourceArtifact records (candidate observations ONLY — claims, never executable artifacts, never authority) with FULL provenance (adapter id, source kind, actor id, content-addressed acquisition-run id, provider run id when returned, fetched-at, raw-result digest), typed failure semantics (unauthorized/payment-required/not-found/rate-limited/timeout/malformed-response/unavailable as typed values — never raw provider errors, never throws), and a deterministic per-day quota guard (EPOCH_APIFY_MAX_RUNS_PER_DAY, default 1; epoch-day window, in-memory per instance by design — a cost guard, not a security boundary). ZERO new dependencies (platform fetch + the frozen kernel contract; injectable fetch for test doubles).
